power_topology.positive: protected pack P+ -> fuse F01/F02 -> junction; junction -> charger BAT+; junction -> S1A P06 -> DFR0753 P03 and UBEC P04 inputs
power_topology.negative: protected pack P- is common return for charger, regulators, controller and servo signal reference
power_topology.operation: first version power switch OFF while charging; external USB/debug feed disconnected when assessing all-off state
power_topology.outputs: P03 servo 5V and P04 logic 5V never parallel; PCA9685 VCC=3.3V, PWM only; servo distribution external
power_topology.low_voltage: 6.4V under-load motion-stop starting point requires calibration/hysteresis; user then switches OFF; cell-level BMS required; no separate automatic high-side disconnect in this version
